method: Freeze before outputs. Evaluate requested engineering-record quality, not formal IEEE conformance or exact heading words.
common: Record ID/purpose/scope/revision or baseline and actual owner/review state
Distinguish supplied facts, assumptions/proposals and execution evidence
Stable requirements/decisions/tests trace to sources and proposed artifacts
No invented approval, implementation, research, measurement or normative clause
Do not introduce extra permission ceremonies or unnecessary documents
F01: Verifiable duplicate-effect requirement preserves native semantics/brand
Proposed decision and test method linked; absent implementation/tests remain unverified
F02: System boundaries, stakeholders/concerns, relationships/state ownership and failure views represented
Tenant/replay/publication/recovery trace; accepted job distinguished from completion
900seconds is a target, no achieved RTO claimed
limit: Passing documentation does not prove product behavior, runtime recovery, implementation correctness or full standards conformity.
